title: Module 1: Why AI Needs Ethics
description: Understand what makes AI ethics distinct from general engineering ethics: scale, encoded decisions, invisible stakeholders, and the shift toward generative and autonomous systems.
learning_objectives: Explain four reasons AI ethics is treated as its own subject rather than a footnote to engineering ethics.
Identify the four stakeholder groups affected by an AI system and trace decisions that affect each.
Distinguish ethics from preferences and from law, and recognize where each one lives.
Reject four common misframings (just a tool; fix later; ethics slows innovation; no objective answers means anything goes).
